+defmodule Paths do
+  @doc """
+  Normalize a path by collapsing dot segments (".") and redundant slashes,
+  but do not allow parent traversal beyond the start of the path. For
+  absolute paths, leading ".." segments are discarded (can't go above root).
+  For relative paths, leading ".." segments are preserved.
+  """
+  def normalize_path(path) when is_binary(path) do
+    absolute = String.starts_with?(path, "/")
+
+    segments = String.split(path, "/", trim: false)
+
+    acc = Enum.reduce(segments, [], fn
+      "" , acc ->
+        # skip empty segments (collapse multiple slashes)
+        acc
+      ".", acc ->
+        # skip current-dir segments
+        acc
+      "..", [] ->
+        # nothing to pop; preserve ".." for relative paths, skip for absolute
+        if absolute, do: [], else: [".."]
+      "..", [".." | _] = acc ->
+        # previous is also "..", keep accumulating
+        [".." | acc]
+      "..", [_ | tail] ->
+        # pop one segment
+        tail
+      segment, acc ->
+        [segment | acc]
+    end)
+
+    segments = Enum.reverse(acc)
+
+    cond do
+      absolute and segments == [] -> "/"
+      absolute -> "/" <> Enum.join(segments, "/")
+      segments == [] -> "."
+      true -> Enum.join(segments, "/")
+    end
+  end
+end
